[EN] [Dungeon - 453] Velik’s Hold
[ES] [Dungeon - 453] Velik’s Hold
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I will investigate the earthquakes.
[ES] Investigaré los terremotos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Seir in Velika.
[ES] Habla con Seir en Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Velik's Steps
[ES] Pasos de Velik
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Earth tremors can be felt more strongly here. This must be the way to the underground.
[ES] Aquí los temblores de tierra se sienten con más fuerza. Este debe ser el camino hacia el subterráneo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Velik's Steps and find the secret entrance to the underground.
[ES] Ve a Velik's Steps y encuentra la entrada secreta al subterráneo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Velik's Underground Passage
[ES] Pasaje subterráneo de Velik
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Arrived at Velik's Underground Passage.
[ES] Llegaste al Pasaje subterráneo de Velik.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the teleportal to enter Velik's Hold, and investigate the earthquakes.
[ES] Usa el teleportal para entrar a Velik's Hold e investiga los terremotos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill all Archdevan soldiers under Velika.
[ES] Mata a todos los soldados archidevas bajo Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Unstable Path
[ES] Camino inestable
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] A massive tremor shakes the area. This may be related to the Archdevan Imperial Army.
[ES] Un temblor masivo sacude la zona. Esto podría estar relacionado con el Ejército Imperial Archideva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Continue investigating.
[ES] Continúa investigando.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Kavador the Pathfinder.
[ES] Derrota a Kavador el Explorador.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Fractured Halls
[ES] Salas Fracturadas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This place also seems to have been occupied by the Archdevan Imperial Army.
[ES] Este lugar también parece haber sido ocupado por el Ejército Imperial Archideva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find clues that link the earthquakes in Velika to the Archdevan Imperial Army.
[ES] Encuentra pistas que vinculen los terremotos en Velika con el Ejército Imperial Archideva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill all Archdevan soldiers occupying the Fractured Halls.
[ES] Mata a todos los soldados archidevas que ocupan las Salas Fracturadas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Prokyon the Cyasmic Mystic Stone.
[ES] Derrota a Prokyon la Piedra Mística Ciasmática.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Velik's Passage
[ES] Pasaje de Velik
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find clues that link the earthquakes in Velika to the Archdevan Imperial Army.
[ES] Encuentra pistas que vinculen los terremotos en Velika con el Ejército Imperial Archideva.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Veldeg the Siegework.
[ES] Derrota a Veldeg la Máquina de Asedio.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Claim reward.
[ES] Reclama la recompensa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to Seir.
[ES] Informa a Seir.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
